description: Simple spatial steel frame analysis with PKPM
message: Use PKPM to run 3D static analysis for a 2-story spatial steel frame with one 6m bay in global X, one 5m bay in global Y, 3.6m story height, fixed column bases, and a 10kN/m2 downward floor load on each story.

assertions.description: The model must be a genuine spatial 3-D steel frame with nodes on at least two distinct global Y-coordinate planes, and the response must describe the requested PKPM analysis without inventing unsupported numerical or engineering conclusions.

Do not create an explicit self-weight load or duplicate a converted load; an analysis provider may apply its configured member self-weight internally. Reconstruct geometry, topology, supports, and load placement from the task.
